issues.description: Function create_controlled_single_qubit_gate has a mismatched parameter order between the template and the specification/solution. The template declares the signature as create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits, target, control, gate_matrix) (i.e., 'target' before 'control'), whereas the problem specification and the reference solution use create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix) (i.e., 'control' before 'target'). This discrepancy (swapped order of the control and target parameters) will confuse students about which argument is which and will break callers/tests that expect the (control, target) ordering.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to match the problem statement and reference solution: def create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits: int, control: int, target: int, gate_matrix: NDArray[np.complex128]) -> DD. Update any internal uses (assertions, comments, and construction) in the template to use the control-before-target ordering so students see a consistent API across specification, stub, and solution.
